instantAnalysis.title: Instant Analysis

expertValidation.title: Expert Validation

continuousLearning.title: Continuous Learning
continuousLearning.description: Every expert validation feeds back into the model, improving accuracy for the whole community.

secure.title: Secure by Design
secure.description: Role-based access for farmers, agronomists, cooperative admins, and system administrators.

regionalCoverage.title: Regional Coverage
regionalCoverage.description: Cooperatives assign agronomists to districts, sectors, and cells so no farmer is left behind.

diseaseClasses.title: 11 Disease Classes
diseaseClasses.description: Focused on Rwanda's key crops — the most common diseases of maize, potato, and tomato.

landing.contextTitle: From Rwanda's fields to real-time diagnosis
landing.contextText1: Crop diseases can wipe out a season's work before a farmer ever reaches an expert. Agri AI closes that gap — a photo taken in the field becomes a diagnosis in seconds, reviewed by a real agronomist who knows your district.
landing.contextText2: Every prediction carries the climate context of your exact location: rainfall, temperature, and humidity trends — so advice fits your field, not a generic textbook.
landing.ctaSubtitle: Register with a code from your cooperative and start detecting diseases today.

footer.mission: Protecting harvests, one photo at a time
